results.question: 各门店销售额排名
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

results.question: 华东区近30天销售额最高的门店是哪个
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.region = '华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.store_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id = o.store_id AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' WHERE s.region = '华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 各区域销售额占比

results.question: 分析华东区最近销售情况
sqls: SELECT s.store_name, s.manager, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region='华东' GROUP BY s.id, s.store_name, s.manager ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales FROM orders o JOIN store s ON o.store_id=s.id WHERE s.region='华东' AND o.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY date

results.question: 对比华东和华北两个区域的销售表现
sqls: SELECT s.region, COUNT(o.order_id) as orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0) as sales, COALESCE(SUM(o.refund_amount),0) as refund_amount FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as store_count, COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id),0),2) as refund_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)/COUNT(DISTINCT s.id),2) as avg_sales_per_store FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY sales DESC

SELECT s.region, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as store_count, COUNT(o.order_id) as total_orders, COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END) as refund_orders, ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN o.refund_amount>0 THEN 1 END)*100.0/NULLIF(COUNT(o.order_id),0))::numeric,2) as refund_rate, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.amount),0)/COUNT(DISTINCT s.id))::numeric,2) as avg_sales_per_store FROM store s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.id=o.store_id WHERE s.region IN ('华东','华北') GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC

results.question: 上月销售冠军门店的成功因素分析
帮我看看最近一周的情况
退款最多的那个门店的会员情况
sqls: SELECT store_id, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount)::numeric, 2) as total_refund, COUNT(*) as refund_orders FROM orders WHERE refund_amount > 0 GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY total_refund DESC

SELECT m.member_id, m.name, m.level, m.register_date, m.last_consume_date, m.total_amount, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_cnt, ROUND(SUM(o.amount)::numeric,2) as store_spend, ROUND(SUM(o.refund_amount)::numeric,2) as store_refund FROM member m JOIN orders o ON m.member_id = o.member_id AND o.store_id = 86 GROUP BY m.member_id, m.name, m.level, m.register_date, m.last_consume_date, m.total_amount ORDER BY store_spend DESC

SELECT m.level, COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as member_cnt, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)*100.0/SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)) OVER(),2) as pct FROM member m JOIN orders o ON m.member_id = o.member_id AND o.store_id = 86 GROUP BY m.level ORDER BY member_cnt DESC
